description: This file provides utility functions for handling binary blobs, including reading a file into memory and writing memory blobs to a file. It also defines optimized methods for probing and writing data using macros.

methods.name: void * fy_blob_read(const char * file,size_t * sizep)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into memory, returning a pointer to the allocated buffer and setting the size.

methods.name: int fy_blob_write(const char * file,const void * blob,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a memory blob to a specified file, creating or overwriting the file.
